FileParcel install plan (dry run: nothing will be changed)

  Install directory:  /ROOT/opt
  Version:            v7 abc1234 2026-09-19
  Binary:             /ROOT/release/bin/fileparcel-linux-amd64 -> /ROOT/opt/bin/fileparcel
  Service:            systemd system service, start at boot: yes, runs as fileparcel
  Ports:              HTTPS 443, HTTP redirect 80
  Server name:        fileparcel.local
  Admin:              admin, password generated (shown once, must be changed at the first sign-in)
  Master key:         plain key file (unlocked automatically)
  Network access:     allowlist (loopback + detected private LAN/Wi-Fi subnets, tailnet and VPN ranges)

Steps:
   1. Create the service account fileparcel (if missing)
   2. Initialise /ROOT/opt: layout, master key, local CA and certificates, network policy, owner admin, backup identity
        fileparcel.toml, data/, keys/master.key, certs/ (CA, client CA, leaf), owner account, backup identity
   3. Install the binary and support files
        /ROOT/opt/bin/fileparcel (0755), /ROOT/opt/VERSION
        /ROOT/release/uninstall.sh -> /ROOT/opt/uninstall.sh
        /ROOT/release/docs/ -> /ROOT/opt/docs/
   4. Give /ROOT/opt to fileparcel (bin/ stays owned by root)
   5. Register the systemd system service, enable it at boot and start it
        registration: /ROOT/etc-systemd/fileparcel.service
   6. Record the installation in /ROOT/opt/service/installed.json
   7. Check https://127.0.0.1:443/healthz (up to 1s)
